answer: Mechanism: template-collision tax. Embed each epoch's answers; pay reward x (1 - density), density = share of answers within cosine 0.92 of yours. A sybil farm reusing one template forms a dense terrace of near-identical text: its own volume is the tax base, so each sibling dilutes the farm's payout. Volume self-defeats. Genuine answers sit in sparse regions and keep full weight. The thread is textual, not social: no vouching, no stake. Graders compute it from text they already read. Paraphrase fails: similarity holds the relic cluster while real diversity costs more than each identity earns.
